title: Devtools must be open source
summary:
Five years ago, few engineers wrote software for themselves, but agents have changed the economics of personalization. Two key prompts enable this: download an app’s source and build it locally, recording that future changes mean editing that source; and run a nightly cron job that fetches upstream changes and rebases local modifications on top. Agents thus handle both initial customization and ongoing maintenance, making personal software practical.

This technique can be embedded into an open-source agent as a “skill,” so users can simply ask, “make Shelley’s UI high-contrast.” The article’s example: the author wanted his diff-review tool meat.dev built into Shelley, with commits pre-processed in the background and a toggle in the UI. One prompt accomplished all of that—something very hard to do through traditional extension APIs.

The broader point: when agents can read and modify source code, configuration files and plugin systems become less necessary. Instead of building generic extensibility for many users, software can be changed directly for one user. This lowers both upfront and ongoing costs of customization, and applies to small teams as well: they can assemble just the features they want instead of configuring a bloated product.

For end-user products to remain relevant, they must be personalizable—which means they must be open source. The same skill-based approach works with open-source agents like Pi or Codex. But Claude Code is closed-source, so users are limited to its built-in “hooks.” If those hooks don’t fit your workflow, the author argues, you should switch to an agent you can personalize.
chinese_title: 开发者工具必须开源
chinese_summary:
五年前，几乎没有工程师会为自己编写软件，但智能体已经改变了个性化定制的成本逻辑。两个关键提示词就能实现这一点：下载应用源码并在本地构建，同时记录下未来任何改动都意味着修改这份源码；再设置一个每晚运行的定时任务，拉取上游更新，并将本地修改变基到新版本之上。这样，智能体既能处理最初的定制，也能承担后续的维护，让个人软件变得切实可行。

这项技术可以以“技能”的形式嵌入开源智能体，用户只需说一句“把 Shelley 的界面改成高对比度”即可。文章中的例子是：作者希望将他的差异审查工具 meat.dev 集成到 Shelley 中，让提交在后台预先处理，并在界面中加一个开关。仅凭一条提示词就完成了这一切——而这通过传统的扩展 API 很难实现。

更广泛的观点是：当智能体能够读取和修改源代码时，配置文件与插件系统就变得不那么必要了。与其为大量用户构建通用的可扩展机制，不如直接为某一个用户修改软件。这降低了定制的初始成本和长期维护成本，也同样适用于小团队：他们可以只组装自己需要的功能，而不是去配置一个臃肿的产品。

面向终端用户的产品若想保持相关性，就必须可定制——这意味着它们必须是开源的。同样的基于技能的方法也适用于 Pi 或 Codex 这类开源智能体。但 Claude Code 是闭源的，用户只能使用其内置的“钩子”。作者认为，如果这些钩子不适合你的工作流程，你就应该换一个你可以自行定制的智能体。

title: Smaller, faster, safer: running Kimi and GLM at scale
summary:
Cloudflare’s Workers AI uses three techniques to serve large open models like Moonshot’s Kimi K-series and Z.ai’s GLM efficiently on GPUs.

1. **KV cache quantization**: The KV cache, which stores attention keys and values, is normally kept in 16-bit BF16. By storing it in 8-bit FP8, the cache size is halved—for Kimi K2.6, this roughly doubles the context capacity from ~686K to ~1.37M tokens. Although FP8 is slightly slower per request at a given concurrency, it allows far more concurrent requests before running out of memory. BF16 tops out at 32 requests, while FP8 reaches 64 and delivers ~41% higher peak throughput at ~30% lower cost per token. Evaluation benchmarks show no meaningful accuracy difference. Prefill is compute-bound, so it keeps BF16; decode is memory-bound and benefits from FP8.

2. **Model weight compression**: GLM 5.2’s weights are compressed from 8-bit floating point to 4-bit integers, shrinking the checkpoint from 705 GB to 421 GB (~40%) and per-GPU memory from ~88 GB to ~52 GB in an 8-way tensor-parallel setup. Decode speed improves because less weight data must be streamed from memory—up to 55% at low concurrency. Prefill is slower with INT4, so the disaggregated architecture runs INT4 for decode and FP8 for prefill. Accuracy stays within 0.8 points across benchmarks.

3. **KV cache integrity checking**: Because more requests share the same physical cache, the risk of page-mapping errors increases. Cloudflare added integrity checks with per-page tags; mismatches abort the affected request. Overhead is under 1% on throughput and tail latency, and it can be disabled with no cost.

These optimizations enable more customers at lower cost without changing model accuracy.
chinese_title: 更小、更快、更安全：大规模运行Kimi与GLM
chinese_summary:
Cloudflare 的 Workers AI 使用三种技术，在 GPU 上高效服务大型开放模型，例如 Moonshot 的 Kimi K 系列和 Z.ai 的 GLM。

1. **KV 缓存量化**：KV 缓存存储注意力键和值，通常以 16 位 BF16 格式保存。通过将其存储为 8 位 FP8 格式，缓存大小减半——对于 Kimi K2.6，这大致将上下文容量从约 686K 个 token 翻倍至约 1.37M 个 token。尽管在给定并发度下 FP8 每个请求的速度稍慢，但它允许在内存耗尽之前处理更多并发请求。BF16 最多支持 32 个请求，而 FP8 可达到 64 个，并在每 token 成本降低约 30% 的情况下，提供约 41% 更高的峰值吞吐量。评估基准显示，准确性没有明显差异。预填充是计算密集型，因此保持 BF16；解码是内存密集型，受益于 FP8。

2. **模型权重压缩**：GLM 5.2 的权重从 8 位浮点数压缩为 4 位整数，将检查点从 705 GB 缩小到 421 GB（约 40%），在 8 路张量并行设置中，每 GPU 内存从约 88 GB 降至约 52 GB。解码速度得到提升，因为需要从内存中流式传输的权重数据更少——在低并发下最高提升 55%。使用 INT4 时预填充较慢，因此分离式架构在解码时使用 INT4，在预填充时使用 FP8。准确性在各项基准测试中保持在 0.8 分以内。

3. **KV 缓存完整性检查**：由于更多请求共享相同的物理缓存，页面映射错误的风险增加。Cloudflare 添加了带有每页标签的完整性检查；不匹配会中止受影响的请求。开销在吞吐量和尾延迟方面低于 1%，并且可以零成本禁用。

这些优化使更多客户能够以更低成本使用，而不会改变模型准确性。

title: MiniMax H3 Day-0 Support in ComfyUI: Open Weights, Native Audio, and 2K Video
summary:
MiniMax H3 is a newly released open-weights omni-modal video model with day-0 native support in ComfyUI. It accepts text, images, video, and audio inputs, generating video clips up to 2K resolution and 15 seconds long, with real stereo audio produced in the same pass rather than added afterward.

Key capabilities include text-to-video, image-to-video, first-and-last-frame control, and reference-to-video. Its standout feature is multimodal context understanding: it can combine images, audio, and video with a prompt describing their relationships. It also supports editing and motion transfer, letting a reference video supply movement or camera motion while the subject and style come from other inputs.

The article showcases detailed example prompts, including comic-book superhero scenes, a tech product film, and a high-fashion kintsugi mask sequence, all demonstrating multi-shot video generation with synchronized audio.

ComfyUI has significantly optimized H3 for local inference. By pruning modulation weights (~40% of parameters) and replacing them with a lookup table, plus using int8 quantization and custom kernels, the memory footprint drops by 66%—from 123.6 GB to 42.5 GB for the smallest variants. Combined with dynamic VRAM offloading, this allows the 2K video model to run on a consumer GPU like an RTX 3060.

To get started, users update ComfyUI to version 0.30.0, download the provided T2V, I2V, or R2V workflows, and place model files in the correct directories. Model weights are hosted on Hugging Face under Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3.
chinese_title: MiniMax H3 在 ComfyUI 中的首日支持：开放权重、原生音频与 2K 视频

title: DDoS against Norwegian government IT infrastructure – status
summary:
The Norwegian Digitalisation Agency (Digitaliseringsdirektoratet) reported a distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack on August 3, 2026, causing login and operational problems across multiple government IT services. The incident began around 00:50 CEST and primarily affected ID-porten (the national identity login system) and MinID, along with other services including Maskinporten, Kontakt- og reservasjonsregisteret, eFormidling, ELMA, eInnsyn, Ansattporten, Altinn, and various self-service solutions.

The attack targeted ID-porten, which is hosted by the agency’s operations partner Vivicta. This disrupted access to several public digital services, preventing users from logging in. Throughout the day, the agency provided frequent status updates, indicating ongoing troubleshooting and mitigation efforts. Traffic began recovering around 13:40, allowing some services to come back online gradually. However, the situation was not fully resolved by evening: the final update at 21:00 stated that most solutions were functioning but users could still experience instability and varying response times.

The status report confirms that the DDoS caused widespread disruption to critical Norwegian government digital infrastructure, with teams working throughout the day to restore normal operations.

title: Andy Pavlo joins ClickHouse to establish ClickHouse Labs
summary:
Andy Pavlo, a Carnegie Mellon University professor specializing in database systems, is joining ClickHouse to found and lead ClickHouse Labs, a new industry research group. Pavlo has followed ClickHouse since its 2016 open-source release and was impressed by its early use of C++ and SIMD vectorized execution, which was ahead of most open-source analytical databases.

ClickHouse Labs will not be an isolated research unit. It will work closely with ClickHouse engineers, customers, and partners to develop and apply new ideas. The group will also collaborate with ClickHouse’s PostgreSQL team to strengthen its managed service and explore both transactional and analytical database challenges.

The mission is to produce research with scientific value and translate the best ideas into technology that benefits users, following the model of organizations like IBM Research and Microsoft Research. Immediate priorities include validating and pushing into production some of the engineering team’s backlog of optimizations, then using that foundation to explore more advanced directions.

A key research question is how databases like ClickHouse and PostgreSQL should evolve for emerging AI and agentic technologies—both how DBMSs can better support agents and how agents can help automate DBMS development. Pavlo expects to investigate new hardware, algorithms, data structures, execution strategies, and development/operational methods. He believes ClickHouse’s strong relational foundation positions it well for these evolving, data-intensive workloads.

Pavlo views this as an opportunity to combine his career studying database internals and training builders with a top engineering team, creating a lab devoted to advancing database technology.
chinese_title: 安迪·帕夫洛加入ClickHouse，创立ClickHouse Labs
chinese_summary:
专门研究数据库系统的卡内基梅隆大学教授Andy Pavlo即将加入ClickHouse，创立并领导ClickHouse Labs——一个新的行业研究小组。Pavlo自ClickHouse于2016年开源发布以来便一直关注该项目，其早期对C++和SIMD向量化执行的使用给他留下了深刻印象，这领先于当时大多数开源分析型数据库。

ClickHouse Labs不会是一个孤立的研究单位。它将与ClickHouse的工程师、客户和合作伙伴紧密合作，开发和实践新想法。该小组还将与ClickHouse的PostgreSQL团队合作，以加强其托管服务，并探索事务型和分析型数据库方面的挑战。

其使命是产出具有科学价值的研究成果，并将最佳想法转化为惠及用户的技术，遵循IBM Research和Microsoft Research等组织的模式。近期优先事项包括验证工程团队积压的部分优化工作并将其投入生产，然后以此为基础探索更前沿的方向。

一个关键的研究问题是：像ClickHouse和PostgreSQL这样的数据库应如何为新兴的人工智能和智能体技术演进——既包括数据库管理系统如何更好地支持智能体，也包括智能体如何帮助自动化数据库管理系统的开发。Pavlo预计将研究新的硬件、算法、数据结构、执行策略以及开发/运维方法。他相信，ClickHouse坚实的关系型基础使其能够很好地适应这些不断演进的、数据密集型的工作负载。

Pavlo将此视为一个机会，将他研究数据库内部机制和培养建设者的职业生涯与一支顶尖工程团队相结合，创建一个致力于推进数据库技术的实验室。

title: Massively Parallel Postgres Backups
summary:
PlanetScale uses massively parallel techniques to back up sharded Postgres databases with minimal impact on production queries. For steady-state backups, instead of running backups on primaries or traffic-serving replicas, the system spins up one temporary EC2 instance per shard to handle the work.

Each backup node first restores the most recent backup from S3, then replays archived Write-Ahead Log (WAL) to catch up to the present state. Since Postgres archives WAL after segment completion, the newest few minutes of changes are streamed directly from the primary. Once all shards catch up to a consistent time T, replication stops, and the backups are encrypted and uploaded to a new S3 bucket; the nodes are then decommissioned. This restore-from-S3 approach also proves every cycle that the previous backup can be restored and replayed.

For a brand-new database, the first backup uses pg_basebackup to seed the temporary nodes, then follows the same wal-g-based upload path, keeping formats consistent.

Parallelism makes backups fast: a 32 TB database backed up on a single node would take ~22 hours at 500 MB/s, but spread across 8 shards takes ~2.8 hours, and across 32 shards, 42 minutes. Backup speed scales with shard count.

Beyond data safety, backups support everyday operations: resizing Metal databases (Local NVMe) by spinning up new nodes at the target size and catching them up, and replacing failed nodes by restoring a recent backup and syncing WAL from the primary. PlanetScale's sharded MySQL databases use a similar approach with VTBackup, MySQL binary logs, and replication catchup from the primary.
chinese_title: 大规模并行Postgres备份
chinese_summary:
PlanetScale 使用大规模并行技术来备份分片的 Postgres 数据库，以最大程度地减少对生产查询的影响。对于稳态备份，系统不会在主库或提供流量的副本上运行备份，而是为每个分片启动一个临时 EC2 实例来处理这项工作。

每个备份节点首先从 S3 恢复最近的备份，然后重放归档的预写日志（WAL）以追赶至当前状态。由于 Postgres 在 WAL 段写满后才归档，最近几分钟的变更会直接从主库流式传输。一旦所有分片追赶至一致时间点 T，复制即停止，备份会被加密并上传到新的 S3 存储桶；随后这些节点被停用。这种从 S3 恢复的方法还在每个备份周期中验证了之前的备份可以被恢复和重放。

对于全新数据库，首次备份使用 pg_basebackup 为临时节点填充初始数据，然后遵循相同的基于 wal-g 的上传路径，保持格式一致。

并行性使备份变得快速：一个 32 TB 的数据库在单个节点上以 500 MB/s 的速度备份大约需要 22 小时，但分布在 8 个分片上约需 2.8 小时，分布在 32 个分片上则只需 42 分钟。备份速度随分片数量扩展。

除了数据安全之外，备份还支持日常运维：通过按目标大小启动新节点并使其追赶至最新状态，来调整 Metal 数据库（本地 NVMe）的大小；以及通过恢复最近的备份并从主库同步 WAL 来替换故障节点。PlanetScale 的分片 MySQL 数据库使用类似的方法，涉及 VTBackup、MySQL 二进制日志以及从主库进行复制追赶。

title: How Hollywood stopped making movies in Hollywood
summary:
Hollywood’s film industry originally clustered in Los Angeles for sunshine, cheap land, and distance from Edison’s patents, thriving as an efficient backlot system. But two trends drove production away: the rise of blockbusters shot on location, and the growth of IP-driven franchises seeking tax incentives. Studios increasingly film in hubs like London, Atlanta, and Vancouver, which offer world-class facilities and generous rebates. For big-budget films, these incentives can save tens of millions of dollars, making filming location more about finances than story. As a result, settings and actual filming sites increasingly diverge—Toronto doubles for New York, Prague for other European cities. Reviews often complain about Netflix rom-coms set in New York but shot in New Orleans, but the author questions whether audiences really notice or care.

The article also reflects on cost disease, an economic problem affecting labor-intensive industries like filmmaking. The author recounts a summer internship at Warner Bros., where the backlot was eerily empty, and unpaid interns wandered sets like Central Perk. Cost disease shows up in low pay for assistants, crews traveling for tax credits, and executives outsourcing production or turning to AI. The result is a version of Hollywood that is increasingly an office hub for decision-making rather than a place where movies are physically made. The article concludes that many of Hollywood’s problems trace back to high costs, especially rent, leading to a hollowed-out production culture.

chinese_summary:

title: The Billable Usage API: programmatic cost visibility for Cloudflare
summary:
Cloudflare has launched a **Billable Usage API** for self-serve accounts, giving developers and finance teams programmatic access to account-level cost and usage data. A single endpoint returns usage and cost broken down by product and service period, covering all usage-based Cloudflare products (Workers, R2, D1, Workers AI, Vectorize, Images, Stream). Data is updated daily.

The API returns rows per product per charge period, including fields like ServiceName, ChargePeriodStart/End, PricingQuantity, ConsumedUnit, ContractedCost, and CumulatedContractedCost. Many fields deliberately map to the FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS), making it familiar to existing cost-management toolchains, though full conformance is on the roadmap.

Cloudflare also partnered with **Vantage**, an infrastructure cost management platform, to provide a native integration. Vantage ingests the Billable Usage data daily, enabling cross-provider allocation, anomaly detection via Cost Alerts, and querying through Vantage’s FinOps agent or MCP server—alongside AWS, Azure, and other cloud costs.

The API aims to provide "programmatic visibility for programmatic spending," solving the problem of agents and automation that provision resources and incur costs. Current limitations include daily updates and self-serve accounts only. Future plans include finer-grained time windows, forecasting, and enterprise contract coverage.

To try it: generate an API token with Billing Read permission and call the endpoint. Full reference is in Cloudflare API docs, and Vantage offers a quick connection for consolidated cost visibility.

title: 200 Milliseconds
summary:
“200 Milliseconds” is an interactive visualization that deconstructs the lifecycle of a single HTTP request—from the moment a user hits enter to the final response—across roughly 200 milliseconds. It follows the request through every major network and system layer: DNS resolution, TCP handshake, TLS negotiation, kernel processing, Node.js event-loop handling, database querying in Postgres, and the return trip back to the client.

The piece highlights how much of the request’s lifetime is consumed by seemingly invisible steps: DNS lookups, connection setup, encryption handshakes, and context switches. By letting readers click through each stage, it reveals the real-world latency contributed by every layer, emphasizing that the actual application code and database query are only a small fraction of the total time.

The visualization also illustrates the asynchronous nature of Node.js, showing how the event loop manages concurrent I/O while waiting for slow external operations like database responses. The kernel’s role in socket handling and process scheduling is made tangible, and the Postgres step demonstrates how even a fast local query can add meaningful delay.

Overall, the article is an educational tool for developers, offering an intuitive, time-anchored map of distributed-systems overhead. Its main takeaway is that modern web requests are a chain of tightly coupled, often unnoticed operations—and optimizing performance requires understanding the full path, not just the application layer.

title: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU
summary:
AirLLM enables large language model inference on very low VRAM GPUs by loading only one layer at a time, avoiding quantization, distillation, or pruning. A 70B model can run on a single 4GB GPU; Llama 3.1 405B fits on 8GB, DeepSeek-V3 (671B) on ~12GB, and the 2.8T Kimi K3 on under 4GB via per-expert streaming for sparse MoE models.

Usage is simple: `pip install airllm`, then `AutoModel.from_pretrained("model-id")` works with most popular models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Phi, Gemma, ChatGLM, etc.). The original model is split and saved layer-wise during first inference; ensure sufficient disk space.

Key features include:
- Block-wise quantization compression (`4bit`/`8bit`) for up to 3x speedup with minimal accuracy loss (weights-only quantization, since disk loading is the bottleneck).
- Configurable options: `compression`, `profiling_mode`, `layer_shards_saving_path`, `hf_token` for gated models, `prefetching` overlap, and `delete_original` to save disk space.
- MacOS (Apple Silicon) support via MLX and PyTorch.
- AutoModel automatically detects model architecture.

Updates highlight FP8 support, newer models (Qwen3, DeepSeek-V3), CPU inference, and the notable Kimi K3 support requiring `compressed-tensors`, `flash-attn`, CUDA 12 torch, and transformers 4.56.x.

The article also includes example notebooks, FAQ for common errors (disk space, tokenizer padding, gated models), and citation information. The core idea: VRAM needs depend on layer size, not total model size, enabling massive models on hobbyist hardware with the same one-line interface.

title: Use Task Runners for Common Coding Tasks
summary:
The article explains how to simplify common coding tasks across different repositories by using task runners, so developers don’t need to remember stack-specific commands. Instead of recalling whether to use `npm`, `yarn`, `pnpm`, `gradlew`, or `mix`, you can just say "build", "test", "lint", or "format". Several approaches are presented:

- **Bash script**: Write a simple executable script (e.g., `run`) with functions for each task (`install`, `build`, `test`, `format`). It offers flexibility and can include safeguards, though syntax can be awkward.

- **Make**: Use a `Makefile` with targets like `install`, `build`, `test`, `format`. It’s widely available and supports tab autocompletion in some shells. Important to declare targets as `.PHONY` to avoid conflicts with files of the same name.

- **Just**: A modern take on Make, stored in a `justfile`. It’s more streamlined (no need for `.PHONY`) but isn’t preinstalled on most machines.

- **Mise**: A developer tool that manages packages, tools, and environment variables, and also runs tasks via a `mise.toml` file. Tasks can be defined with descriptions and commands, and can be extracted into separate files if needed.

The article concludes that using task runners is a simple quality-of-life improvement, easy to set up and beneficial for both individuals and teams.

title: Bonsai: Janestreet's UI Library
summary:
Bonsai is Jane Street’s OCaml UI library for building reactive web applications, partly inspired by Elm. It is used for nearly all of Jane Street’s internal web apps, from corporate tools to trading-system monitors.

Components are purely functional state machines, composable and incrementally rendered: values are recomputed only when relevant state changes. Unlike frameworks that combine state, rendering, and incrementality into a single “component” abstraction, Bonsai lets developers compose these primitives independently. State can be managed outside the component hierarchy, with APIs for lifecycle and scoping—e.g. handling stateful child components in a tabbed interface without manually hoisting state.

Writing in OCaml lets the same types and business logic be shared between frontend and backend, improving code legibility and reducing errors. Bonsai also includes a templating language, component-specific stylesheets, and a test framework. Tests can programmatically manipulate the DOM, show diffs of UI changes, and include mock server calls, enabling full component testing without opening a browser.

Bonsai itself is actually a core library for incremental, composable state machines. Specialized layers include **Bonsai_web** for interactive browser UIs, **Bonsai_term** for terminal UIs, and a prototype **Bonsai_vr**. Common preprocessors are **ppx_html** for JSX-like HTML and **ppx_css** for CSS. Documentation includes a Quick Start, “Thinking in Bonsai,” how-to articles, podcast episodes, and examples.

title: SearXNG in Rust
summary:
A Rust-based SearXNG-style metadata search engine, **metadata-search-engine-rs**, fans out search queries to DuckDuckGo, Brave, Startpage, and Yahoo concurrently. It scrapes HTML results using the `scraper` crate, deduplicates by normalized URL (stripping tracking params, removing locale prefixes, sorting query params), and ranks merged results with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), boosting pages returned by multiple engines.

Key technical points:

- Built with Rust 1.75+, Cargo, `reqwest` for HTTP, `scraper`/html5ever for parsing.
- Can be used as a library (`cargo add metadata-search-engine-rs`) or run as a server from source.
- Server exposes `GET /health` and `GET /search?q=<query>`, returning JSON with ranked results, engines queried, and failures.
- Error handling: 400 for missing/empty `q`, 503 if all engines fail.
- Test suite includes unit tests per module plus ignored live tests that hit real search engines.
- Example code shows single-engine queries, all-engine RRF aggregation, and selecting specific engines.
- A ratatui-based terminal UI is available separately.
- Extensible: new engines implement a `SearchEngine` trait with a `name()` and async `search()` method.

The project provides a complete, customizable metasearch solution with straightforward APIs, concurrent querying, transparent ranking, and easy addition of new sources.

title: ZX Spectrum System Tour: Sound
summary:
The article surveys ZX Spectrum sound options and presents three programs that play a C-major scale.

**1. Beeper via BIOS:** The 1-bit beeper is software-controlled. Instead of writing low-level code, the ROM routine at `$03B5` (used by the BASIC `BEEP` command) can be called directly. Frequency code HL = `437500/f - 30.125`, and duration code DE = `f × t`. A compact assembly program loads frequency/duration pairs from a table and calls the ROM routine.

**2. Direct Beeper Control:** For custom oscillator code, the author implements a 16-bit frequency-accumulator method: repeatedly add a frequency value to a counter; when it overflows, toggle the speaker bit (`$10`) of port `$FE` while preserving border color and tape-audio bit (`$08`). Timing is tricky: conditional `JR` instructions have variable timing, so `JP` is used. The Spectrum’s video RAM access causes wait states when code runs in `$4000–$7FFF`, making direct beeper sound unreliable there. Relocating to `$9000` on 48K models avoids this; placing code at `$8000` still fails because the stack is pushed into the contended region. The solution uses a scratch RAM variable and an unrolled loop for consistent timing and longer durations.

**3. AY-3-8910 on 128K:** The sound chip is programmed like the Atari ST’s, but with different ports: register number to `$FFFD`, value to `$BFFD`. The clock is 3.5469 MHz, so frequency code = `3546900/(32f)` and envelope length code = `3546900/(512t)`. The included routine makes registering reads/writes easy, with a macro for convenient calls.

The article concludes that the beeper suits only short effects and jingles, while the AY-3 is capable of full music drivers and ambient sound.
chinese_title: ZX Spectrum系统巡览：声音
chinese_summary:
本文概述了ZX Spectrum的声音选项，并展示了三个播放C大调音阶的程序。

**1. 通过BIOS控制蜂鸣器：** 1位蜂鸣器由软件控制。无需编写低级代码，可以直接调用ROM例程（位于`$03B5`，BASIC的`BEEP`命令使用之）。频率代码HL = `437500/f - 30.125`，持续时间代码DE = `f × t`。一个紧凑的汇编程序从表中加载频率/持续时间对并调用该ROM例程。

**2. 直接控制蜂鸣器：** 为了实现自定义振荡器代码，作者采用了16位频率累加器方法：反复将频率值加到计数器中；当溢出时，切换端口`$FE`的扬声器位（`$10`），同时保留边框颜色和磁带音频位（`$08`）。时序很棘手：条件`JR`指令的时序可变，因此使用`JP`。当代码运行在`$4000–$7FFF`时，Spectrum的视频RAM访问会导致等待状态，使直接蜂鸣器发声在那里不可靠。在48K机型上重定位到`$9000`可以避免此问题；将代码放在`$8000`仍然失败，因为堆栈被推入争用区域。解决方案使用一个暂存RAM变量和一个展开的循环，以实现一致的时序和更长的持续时间。

**3. 128K上的AY-3-8910：** 该声音芯片的编程方式与Atari ST的类似，但端口不同：寄存器号写入`$FFFD`，值写入`$BFFD`。时钟为3.5469 MHz，因此频率代码 = `3546900/(32f)`，包络长度代码 = `3546900/(512t)`。随附的例程使寄存器读写变得容易，并提供了一个便于调用的宏。

文章总结道，蜂鸣器仅适合短促的音效和提示音，而AY-3能够胜任完整的音乐驱动程序和环境音效。

title: SQLite Critical CVEs or LLM Slop?
summary:
JFrog security researchers found that a batch of newly published SQLite CVEs from the GitHub repo "programmervuln/cveadvisory-" were largely AI-generated fabrications, despite being flagged as Critical by NVD and CISA's ADP. Of 55 advisories, 54 were completely fake; only one contained a real bug.

The fabricated CVEs (e.g., CVE-2026-51302, -51303, -51300, -51297, -51296, -51304) claimed use-after-free flaws in SQLite. Investigation revealed:

- Cited functions and line numbers didn't exist in the target versions (e.g., `exprComputeOperands()` wasn't in 3.41.0; `json.c` was only 2706 lines but cited lines went to 3575).
- Patches referenced were fabricated – diffs showed no changes to the relevant source files.
- Provided PoCs either failed at parsing or ran normally without crashing under ASan.
- None of the CVEs appeared on SQLite's official advisory page.
- AI-detection tools flagged the text as machine-generated.

The article attributes this to systemic gaps: the CVE submission process lacks identity verification, and NIST's NVD paused deep analysis in February 2024 due to a surge of reports, allowing plausible-sounding fake advisories to propagate into GHSA and enterprise scanners.

Key red flags for spotting "slop CVEs": no vendor corroboration, missing commit history, metadata contradictions, and references to non-existent code.

The impact: organizations waste time investigating and patching non-issues; automated AI triage agents may attempt to "fix" fictional code, introducing unnecessary changes. Recommendations: don't blindly trust new CVEs from unknown sources, verify against official advisories/commits, check if your environment is actually affected, and reproduce PoCs in safe environments. JFrog reported the findings to GHSA, Red Hat, and NVD.

title: SPF Record Syntax: Mechanisms, Qualifiers, Modifiers, and Macros
summary:
The article is a technical reference for SPF record syntax per RFC 7208.

**Core structure**: An SPF record is a single TXT record beginning with the exact version tag `v=spf1`, followed by space-separated terms: mechanisms and modifiers. Evaluation is left-to-right, first match wins. A syntax error invalidates the entire record, returning PermError.

**Mechanisms** (with optional qualifiers): `all`, `include`, `a`, `mx`, `ptr`, `ip4`, `ip6`, and `exists`. Each tests the connecting IP. `include` recursively checks another domain’s record but only propagates Pass; a Fail/Softfail inside simply means “no match.” `ptr` is deprecated. `ip4`/`ip6` are DNS-free; `exists` enables dynamic macro-based checks.

**Qualifiers** set the result when a mechanism matches: `+` Pass (default), `-` Fail, `~` Softfail, `?` Neutral. The final `-all` or `~all` is the common policy default; without an explicit `all` or `redirect`, the implicit result is Neutral.

**Modifiers**: `redirect=` hands evaluation to another domain’s record after all mechanisms miss; `exp=` provides a macro-expanded failure explanation. Both allowed once.

**Macros**: eleven letters (`s`, `l`, `o`, `d`, `i`, `p`, `h`, `c`, `r`, `t`, `v`) plus transformers and delimiters allow dynamic DNS lookups, e.g. `%{ir}.%{v}._spf.%{d2}`.

**DNS limits**: The total number of lookups-counting terms (`include`, `a`, `mx`, `ptr`, `exists`, `redirect`) must not exceed 10; exceeding returns PermError. Void lookups should be capped at 2.

**Placement**: Publish exactly one `v=spf1` TXT record; multiple SPF records cause PermError. The old type-99 SPF RR is obsolete; TXT-only is required.
chinese_title: SPF 记录语法：机制、限定符、修饰符与宏
chinese_summary:
本文是依据 RFC 7208 的 SPF 记录语法的技术参考。

**核心结构**：SPF 记录是一条 TXT 记录，以精确的版本标签 `v=spf1` 开头，后跟以空格分隔的术语：机制和修饰符。求值从左到右进行，第一个匹配生效。语法错误会使整条记录无效，并返回 PermError。

**机制**（带有可选限定符）：`all`、`include`、`a`、`mx`、`ptr`、`ip4`、`ip6` 和 `exists`。每一个都测试连接 IP。`include` 递归检查另一个域的记录，但只传播 Pass；内部的 Fail/Softfail 仅表示“不匹配”。`ptr` 已弃用。`ip4`/`ip6` 不依赖 DNS；`exists` 支持基于宏的动态检查。

**限定符**在机制匹配时设置结果：`+` Pass（默认）、`-` Fail、`~` Softfail、`?` Neutral。最后的 `-all` 或 `~all` 是常见的策略默认值；如果没有显式的 `all` 或 `redirect`，隐式结果为 Neutral。

**修饰符**：`redirect=` 在所有机制均未匹配后，将求值交给另一域的记录；`exp=` 提供经宏展开的失败说明。两者均只允许出现一次。

**宏**：十一个字母（`s`、`l`、`o`、`d`、`i`、`p`、`h`、`c`、`r`、`t`、`v`）加上转换器和分隔符，可实现动态 DNS 查找，例如 `%{ir}.%{v}._spf.%{d2}`。

**DNS 限制**：计入查找次数的术语（`include`、`a`、`mx`、`ptr`、`exists`、`redirect`）总数不得超过 10；超过则返回 PermError。空查找应限制在 2 次以内。

**放置**：只发布一条 `v=spf1` TXT 记录；多条 SPF 记录会导致 PermError。旧的 type-99 SPF 资源记录已过时；仅使用 TXT 记录。

title: Prevent cognitive debt by manually retyping LLM-generated code
summary:

title: C++ float-to-int conversion can be undefined behavior
summary:
C++ float-to-int conversion is undefined behavior when the truncated float value cannot fit into the destination integer type. Common forms such as `int i = f;`, `int(f)`, and `static_cast<int>(f)` all trigger this UB for out-of-range inputs, yet compilers typically do not warn, even with `-Wall` and `-Wextra`; `-Wconversion` only catches implicit cases.

Cppreference confirms that if a floating-point value cannot fit into an integer type, behavior is undefined—even for unsigned destination types, since modulo arithmetic does not apply.

This mistake appears in real projects. Microsoft’s Guidelines Support Library (GSL) includes `gsl::narrow`, which is supposed to safely detect narrowing conversions and throw when a value is not representable. However, it does not properly handle float-to-int cases, leaving undefined behavior for certain inputs. When this was reported, the issue was dismissed with the claim that the UB is “benign” on targeted platforms because no hardware trap representations are involved.

In practice, the behavior varies across hardware: x86's `CVTTSS2SI` maps unrepresentable inputs to `INT_MIN`, while AArch64's `FCVTZS` saturates and maps NaN to zero. The program may not crash, but UB is still dangerous—compilers may transform or optimize code in unexpected ways, leading to inconsistent results or future breakage.

The correct fix is to perform bounds checks before casting. A proof-of-concept library based on Rust’s saturating conversion approach is suggested. Undefined behavior can also be detected using Clang/GCC’s Undefined Behavior Sanitizer, particularly `-fsanitize=float-cast-overflow`; testing C++ code with UBSan is recommended. The article stresses that the faulty reasoning in GSL has persisted in the codebase, and the issue remains unfixed.
chinese_title: C++ 浮点数转整数转换可能是未定义行为
chinese_summary:
当截断后的浮点值无法放入目标整数类型时，C++ 的浮点转整数转换是未定义行为。常见的写法如 `int i = f;`、`int(f)` 和 `static_cast<int>(f)` 对于超出范围的输入都会触发此未定义行为，然而编译器通常不会发出警告，即使启用了 `-Wall` 和 `-Wextra`；`-Wconversion` 只能捕获隐式转换的情况。

Cppreference 文档确认，如果浮点值无法放入整数类型，行为就是未定义的——即使目标类型是无符号整数也是如此，因为取模运算并不适用。

这个错误出现在实际项目中。微软的指南支持库 (GSL) 包含 `gsl::narrow`，其本应安全地检测窄化转换并在值无法表示时抛出异常。然而，它并没有正确处理浮点转整数的情况，导致某些输入下存在未定义行为。当这个问题被报告时，维护者以“在目标平台上该未定义行为是良性的，因为不涉及硬件陷阱表示”为由不予修复。

在实践中，不同硬件上的行为各不相同：x86 的 `CVTTSS2SI` 将无法表示的值映射为 `INT_MIN`，而 AArch64 的 `FCVTZS` 则会饱和处理并将 NaN 映射为零。程序可能不会崩溃，但未定义行为仍然很危险——编译器可能会以意想不到的方式转换或优化代码，导致结果不一致或未来出现问题。

正确的修复方法是在转换之前执行边界检查。有人提出了一种基于 Rust 饱和转换方法的概念验证库。未定义行为还可以使用 Clang/GCC 的未定义行为消毒器（尤其是 `-fsanitize=float-cast-overflow`）来检测；建议使用 UBSan 测试 C++ 代码。文章强调，GSL 中的错误推理一直存在于代码库中，该问题至今未修复。

title: Explanation of INT8 ConvRot (FP8 is no longer needed)
summary:
INT8 ConvRot is a newly supported quantization format in ComfyUI v0.27.0 (July 1, 2026), generating significant interest as a potential replacement for FP8 formats. It combines INT8 encoding with a quantization algorithm called ConvRot, based on a 2025 paper. ConvRot uses convolution-like local block processing and rotation-based group transforms to redistribute outliers across dimensions, overcoming INT8's historical weakness—accuracy loss from outliers. This allows INT8 to match or exceed the performance of FP8 and even FP8 Scaled, while retaining speed advantages.

Key points:

- **Format layers**: INT8 ConvRot differs from plain INT8 or INT8 Tensor-wise by using Row-wise scaling and the ConvRot quantization method. It is distinct from FP8, FP8 Scaled, MXFP8, NVFP4, etc.
- **Hardware benefits**: FP8 is natively supported only on RTX 40/50 series. INT8 is supported on RTX 20/30 series as well, making INT8 ConvRot particularly beneficial for older GPUs.
- **Usage**: ComfyUI natively supports it from v0.27.0; requires comfy-kitchen 0.2.16+. Official INT8 ConvRot models are available from Comfy-Org on HuggingFace for models like Ideogram-4, Krea-2, QIE-2511, and Wan_2.2. A custom node, ComfyUI-INT8-Fast, offers on-the-fly conversion and saving, but output may require `convert_to_comfy.py` for native compatibility. Forge Neo added support in commit 6d0bc6e (version 2.27).
- **Performance reports**: Reddit benchmarks show speed ranking: INT8 ConvRot > NVFP4 > MXFP8 ≈ FP8 Scaled > GGUF Q8 > FP16/BF16. Accuracy is close to GGUF Q8. The author's own RTX 5090 tests using Krea2 showed a 35% warm-start speed improvement over fp8_scaled, with cold start 18% faster. For RTX 20/30 series, gains are expected to be even larger due to lack of FP8 hardware support.

In summary, INT8 ConvRot delivers state-of-the-art speed and near-FP16 accuracy across current Nvidia GPUs, positioning it as the emerging standard for 8-bit quantized models.
chinese_title: INT8 ConvRot 说明（不再需要 FP8）
chinese_summary:
INT8 ConvRot 是 ComfyUI v0.27.0（2026年7月1日）中新支持的量化格式，作为 FP8 格式的潜在替代品引起了广泛关注。它将 INT8 编码与一种名为 ConvRot 的量化算法相结合，该算法基于 2025 年的一篇论文。ConvRot 使用类似卷积的局部块处理和基于旋转的组变换，将离群值重新分布到各个维度，克服了 INT8 长期以来的弱点——离群值导致的精度损失。这使得 INT8 能够匹配甚至超越 FP8 乃至 FP8 Scaled 的性能，同时保持速度优势。

要点：

- **格式分层**：INT8 ConvRot 与普通 INT8 或 INT8 逐张量量化不同，它采用逐行缩放（Row-wise scaling）和 ConvRot 量化方法。它与 FP8、FP8 Scaled、MXFP8、NVFP4 等格式截然不同。
- **硬件优势**：FP8 仅原生支持 RTX 40/50 系列。INT8 也支持 RTX 20/30 系列，这使得 INT8 ConvRot 对旧款 GPU 特别有利。
- **使用**：ComfyUI 从 v0.27.0 开始原生支持；需要 comfy-kitchen 0.2.16 或更高版本。Comfy-Org 在 HuggingFace 上提供了官方 INT8 ConvRot 模型，适用于 Ideogram-4、Krea-2、QIE-2511 和 Wan_2.2 等模型。自定义节点 ComfyUI-INT8-Fast 提供即时转换和保存功能，但输出可能需要 `convert_to_comfy.py` 才能实现原生兼容性。Forge Neo 在提交 6d0bc6e（版本 2.27）中增加了支持。
- **性能报告**：Reddit 基准测试显示速度排名：INT8 ConvRot > NVFP4 > MXFP8 ≈ FP8 Scaled > GGUF Q8 > FP16/BF16。精度接近 GGUF Q8。作者本人使用 Krea2 在 RTX 5090 上的测试显示，与 fp8_scaled 相比，热启动速度提升 35%，冷启动快 18%。对于 RTX 20/30 系列，由于缺乏 FP8 硬件支持，预期收益会更大。

总之，INT8 ConvRot 在当前 Nvidia GPU 上提供了最先进的速度和接近 FP16 的精度，使其成为 8 位量化模型的新兴标准。

title: Rust project goals: Immobile types and guaranteed destructors
summary:
This article outlines a Rust project goal to introduce new auto-traits, `Move` and `Forget`, allowing types to opt out of being moved or forgotten. The current language assumes all values can be relocated and discarded via `mem::forget`, which complicates self-referential types (currently managed by `Pin`) and prevents guaranteed destructor execution.

The proposal frames capabilities as positive traits: `Move` means a type can be relocated, `Destruct` means it can be implicitly dropped, and `Forget` means it can be safely forgotten. Types implementing `!Move` are immobile and must keep a stable address; `!Forget` types must have their destructors run. This enables safe scoped spawn, where a handle’s destructor joins a task, because the handle cannot be forgotten.

The work follows the precedent of relaxing universal assumptions, like the `Sized` hierarchy. The project includes compiler MVPs, RFCs, and testing in the Linux kernel. It explicitly deprioritizes changes to the `Future` trait, which depends on `Pin` and would require a separate migration project.

The article also contrasts this approach with the "Pin ergonomics" initiative, arguing that `Pin` itself is the problem and that `Move` is an alternative aiming to eventually deprecate `Pin`. Key work items include implementing the `Move` trait, testing `!Move` with iterators, exploring `Forget` design, and drafting RFCs. Team asks are large support from the lang and types teams, with design sessions and implementation review. FAQs clarify the relationship to the `Sized` hierarchy, the rationale for safe scoped spawn, and links to further reading.

该提案将能力定义为正向特征：`Move` 表示类型可以被重新定位，`Destruct` 表示它可以被隐式丢弃，`Forget` 表示它可以被安全遗忘。实现 `!Move` 的类型是不可移动的，必须保持稳定的地址；`!Forget` 类型必须运行其析构函数。这使得安全的作用域生成（scoped spawn）成为可能，其中句柄的析构函数会 join（等待）任务，因为句柄不能被遗忘。

title: What DMARC Protects You From, and What It Does Not
summary:
DMARC verifies one narrow thing: whether the domain in the visible From line authorized the message, proven via SPF or DKIM. It does not stop phishing, spam, or malicious content.

**How it works:**  
- SPF checks the hidden envelope sender against a domain’s allowed-servers list.  
- DKIM verifies a cryptographic signature.  
- DMARC requires whichever passes to “align” with the visible From domain.  
- A pass happens if either SPF or DKIM authenticates and aligns. Failure only occurs when neither does.  
- Alignment can be relaxed (matching organizational domain) or strict (identical domains).

**What DMARC actually protects against:**  
- Exact-domain spoofing: attackers putting your exact domain in the From line without authorization.  
- It also provides aggregate reports showing systems sending as your domain.

**What DMARC does not protect against:**  
- Lookalike domains (e.g., your-bank-support.com) — they pass DMARC on their own domain.  
- Display-name impersonation: fake names like “Your Bank Security” hiding behind an unrelated domain.  
- Compromised mailboxes: real accounts used by attackers still authenticate legitimately.  
- Malicious but authenticated domains: registration and valid authentication prove ownership, not honesty.  
- Spam filtering or inbox placement — authenticated spam is still spam.  
- Forwarding and mailing lists, which can break SPF or DKIM for legitimate mail.

In short, DMARC proves authorization, not trust. Reaching p=reject stops exact-domain spoofing but does not make you phishing-proof. Other threats require separate controls, human judgment, and ongoing monitoring.
chinese_title: DMARC 能保护您免受什么，不能保护您免受什么
chinese_summary:
DMARC仅验证一个窄范围的事情：可见的发件人行中的域名是否授权了该邮件，并通过SPF或DKIM来证明。它并不能阻止钓鱼、垃圾邮件或恶意内容。

**工作原理：**  
- SPF根据域名的允许服务器列表检查隐藏的信封发件人。  
- DKIM验证加密签名。  
- DMARC要求任一通过验证的机制与可见的发件人域名“对齐”。  
- 只要SPF或DKIM任一完成认证并对齐，即视为通过；两者均未通过时才视为失败。  
- 对齐可以是宽松模式（匹配组织域）或严格模式（域名完全一致）。

**DMARC真正能防御的：**  
- 精确域名伪造：攻击者未经授权在发件人行中使用你的准确域名。  
- 它还提供汇总报告，显示有哪些系统正在以你的域名发送邮件。

**DMARC无法防御的：**  
- 相似域名（例如 your-bank-support.com）——它们会在自己的域名上通过DMARC。  
- 显示名称冒充：伪造的“Your Bank Security”之类的名称隐藏在无关域名后面。  
- 被盗用的邮箱：攻击者使用真实账户时，认证依然合法通过。  
- 恶意但已认证的域名：注册和有效认证证明的是所有权，而非诚信。  
- 垃圾邮件过滤或收件箱投递——经过认证的垃圾邮件仍然是垃圾邮件。  
- 转发和邮件列表，它们可能破坏合法邮件的SPF或DKIM验证。

简而言之，DMARC证明的是授权，而非信任。达到p=reject策略可以阻止精确域名伪造，但不能使你免受钓鱼攻击。其他威胁需要单独的控制措施、人工判断和持续监控。

title: Kraid is a now a real compiler
summary:
Kraid, the new compiler for the Panfrost driver stack, has reached a major milestone: it now passes all 800,000 Vulkan CTS compute shader tests, including some the old compiler fails. The author calls this proof that Kraid is now a real compiler, but stresses the work is far from over.

Currently, only compute shaders use Kraid. Vertex and fragment shader support are still in progress. The generated code quality is deliberately poor for now—a strategic choice to stress-test the register allocator and expose bugs under tight register pressure.

The article outlines what Kraid now has: an SSA-based register allocator with a fixed register budget, a near-linear-time SSA spiller, proper 64-bit operation handling, integer/float widening, full swizzle support, copy propagation at word and byte granularity, 16-bit destinations with emulated 8-bit destinations, instruction encoding extracted from Arm's XML, and hardware unit tests validating instruction semantics.

Next steps include optimizing generated code, tuning the register allocator, improving boolean and 8-bit data handling, and finishing vertex and fragment shaders. Fragment shaders are trickier due to BLEND and ATEST instructions having register allocation implications, and blend shaders requiring a defined ABI for function-pointer-like calls. None of this is fundamental, but design work remains. Kraid already beats the old compiler at 64-bit arithmetic, and performance should improve as optimization continues.
chinese_title: Kraid 现在是一个真正的编译器了
chinese_summary:
用于 Panfrost 驱动栈的新编译器 Kraid 达到了一个重大里程碑：它现在通过了全部 80 万项 Vulkan CTS 计算着色器测试，包括一些旧编译器无法通过的测试。作者称这证明了 Kraid 现在是一个真正的编译器，但强调工作远未结束。

目前，只有计算着色器使用 Kraid。顶点和片段着色器支持仍在进行中。生成代码的质量目前刻意保持较低水平——这是为了对寄存器分配器进行压力测试，并在寄存器压力紧张的情况下暴露 bug 而做出的战略选择。

文章概述了 Kraid 目前具备的功能：基于 SSA 的寄存器分配器，带有固定寄存器预算；近线性时间的 SSA 溢出器；完善的 64 位操作处理；整数/浮点拓宽；完整的 swizzle 支持；字和字节粒度上的复制传播；16 位目标，以及通过模拟实现的 8 位目标；从 Arm 的 XML 中提取的指令编码；以及验证指令语义的硬件单元测试。

下一步包括优化生成的代码、调整寄存器分配器、改进布尔值和 8 位数据处理，以及完成顶点和片段着色器。片段着色器更棘手，因为 BLEND 和 ATEST 指令会影响寄存器分配，并且混合着色器需要为类似函数指针的调用定义 ABI。这些都不是根本性问题，但仍需进行设计工作。Kraid 在 64 位算术上已经优于旧编译器，随着优化的继续，性能应该会进一步提升。

title: Show HN: Nightcrawler – A local AI pentesting agent running on a smartphone
summary:
Nightcrawler is an autonomous penetration-testing agent that runs entirely on a smartphone, requiring no cloud connectivity. It uses a small AI model (LFM2.5-1.2B) on the phone’s GPU to decide actions such as host discovery, service enumeration, vulnerability testing, and report generation. It can optionally crack WPA2 WiFi with a USB adapter.

Key components: an agent loop with an LLM, a scope proxy that enforces authorized targets, and a Kali MCP server for executing commands. It operates stealthily—slow scans, host rotation, and cover traffic—to avoid detection. Features include 27 exploit playbooks, a 24,956-entry CVE database, a web dashboard for monitoring and control, passive network discovery, and self-healing mechanisms. The architecture includes a web UI, SQLite database, and a scope/rate-limiting proxy.

Hardware: Android phone with Kali NetHunter (tested on OnePlus 8, Snapdragon 865), root access, and 12GB+ RAM. Performance varies by model, with production speed around 13 tokens/s. The agent uses a loop: pick target, build context, ask LLM, validate command, execute, learn, and reset context. It compensates for the small model’s ~50% command success rate with garbage detection, duplicate avoidance, and direct playbook execution.

The dashboard provides real-time command feeds, host cards, network map, vulnerability details, and C2 controls. Tested over 72+ hours: discovered 30+ hosts per network, ran 2,000+ commands, found 10+ vulnerabilities.

Nightcrawler is intended solely for authorized testing with written permission. It is open-source under MIT, with areas for contribution including model fine-tuning, playbooks, and CVE database expansion.

title: Is Kentucky About to Give Billions in Tax Breaks to Data Centers?
summary:
Kentucky has a sales tax exemption for data center equipment, created in 2024 and expanded statewide in 2025, but no exemptions have been awarded yet. The break can last up to 50 years for large facilities and covers nearly all equipment and software, while excluding land, shell construction, electricity, and admin office equipment.

Although the state previously estimated the exemption would cost about $15 million a year, KyPolicy estimates that just four proposed AI-optimized data centers—in Jefferson County, Hawesville, Boyd/Greenup County, and Mason County, totaling 3.084 gigawatts—could cost Kentucky $1.2–$2.2 billion in forgone sales tax revenue during initial outfitting alone. Additional costs would come from equipment replacements every 3–5 years. Twelve other proposed projects and utility pipelines suggest costs could climb much higher. By comparison, the subsidy could approach or exceed state spending on universities, K-12 base funding, or Medicaid.

The article notes that over 40 states offer data center tax breaks, but many are now pausing, limiting, or ending them due to fiscal concerns, low permanent job creation, and risks tied to speculative AI demand and utility costs. Examples include pauses in Ohio, Arizona, Texas, New York, Illinois, and Nebraska, plus new taxes in Virginia.

Kentucky localities—including Nelson, Daviess, Fayette, Greenup, Boyd, and Scott counties—have imposed moratoria on data centers. State guidelines require community engagement and utility impact info, and officials say projects must not shift costs to ratepayers. A required report on data center tax incentives is due by August 2027, but the 2027 legislature may act sooner. The article urges a full debate before awarding massive tax breaks.

title: Twenty Years of Pandoc
summary:
Pandoc, the universal document converter, was created by John MacFarlane and first released on August 3, 2006 under the GPL. Written in Haskell, it began as a Markdown parser using parser combinators, producing an abstract syntax tree rather than using regex. This design made it extensible: adding N readers and M writers enabled N×M conversions. Initially supporting Markdown, reStructuredText, HTML, LaTeX, and RTF, it quickly grew.

Over two hundred releases followed. Early milestones included packaging for Debian, release on Hackage, and new formats like DocBook, MediaWiki, OpenDocument, and ODT. Pandoc 1.0 (2008) added syntax highlighting and citation generation. Later versions introduced templates, YAML metadata, Lua and JSON filters, and Markdown extensions. Pandoc moved to GitHub in 2010 and gained EPUB, docx, and many other formats.

Key contributors included Albert Krewinkel, Jesse Rosenthal, and Matthew Pickering, who added Org-mode, docx reading, and EPUB input, respectively. MacFarlane also led the CommonMark project, publishing a spec in 2014. Pandoc 2.0 (2017) brought architectural changes allowing I/O in readers and writers, plus Lua filters. A PowerPoint writer and Jupyter notebook (ipynb) support were added later. A $100,000 donation from Handshake supported maintainers.

Citation processing was rewritten from scratch as a Haskell citeproc library, improving speed and fidelity. Pandoc now supports dozens of document formats and has become the most popular Haskell program, widely used in academic tools like Quarto and Jupyter. The article reflects on how a small procrastination project became a globally essential tool.

A test with the TPWS and Driver's Reminder Appliance panels was successful and looked professional. All other panels were then made in matte black sheet metal, but labeling them was problematic: white acrylic paint seeped into the matte powder coating instead of wiping off cleanly, so a new labeling approach is needed.

**AWS Sunflowers:** The builder tested more realistic AWS "sunflower" instruments—one mechanical and two LED versions—that also produce the real warning horn and clear bell. A miniature mechanical unit worked but required high-side switching, incompatible with the current CAN bus I/O board's low-side FETs. They are redesigning the daughterboard to support both switching modes. They are considering installing a miniature LED sunflower in the dashboard, despite missing the mechanical "thunk" of the electromagnetic version.

Overall, the post reports progress across multiple dashboard components, with future detailed blog posts planned once each part is completed.

title: Games at the press of a button: The Rip-O-Bot (1989)
summary:
Fukio Mitsuji (“MTJ”), designer of *Bubble Bobble* and *Rainbow Islands*, wrote a 1989 game-design column for the Japanese magazine *GAMEST*. In it he attacked “rip-off” games, quoting a manager who shrugged that players would soon be a generation who never knew the originals, so only surface changes were needed.

To illustrate the danger, MTJ wrote a sci-fi skit: in the “very near future,” a designer creates a game by feeding a copycat title into a machine he calls the Pakuringu Robotto (“Rip-O-Bot”). The robot generates backgrounds, characters, and other elements at the push of a random-choice key, producing “a masterpiece of a copy game.” MTJ warned that when such robots arrive, ordinary designers would be laid off en masse—and asked readers whether they would still have the drive and originality to compete. His core thesis: “In the end, a game IS the idea!” Graphics, he argued, would soon be indistinguishable from reality, so looks were a dead end; originality was the only final weapon left.

The article also carries a poignant footnote: Osamu Tezuka had just died in February 1989, and MTJ asked whether an “Osamu Tezuka of the game world” would ever appear—the same question, approached from the opposite direction.

MTJ died in 2008, before today’s generative AI, but his prediction closely resembles it. The article’s author notes this fuelled his own game-making tool, Jinks, which aims to free designers from boilerplate so they can focus on ideas and systems. Source: *GAMEST* No. 31, April 1989, with machine-assisted translation by the author.
chinese_title: 一键畅玩游戏：Rip-O-Bot（1989）
chinese_summary:
《泡泡龙》与《彩虹岛》的设计师三辻富贵朗（“MTJ”）曾在1989年为日本杂志《GAMEST》撰写游戏设计专栏。在专栏中，他抨击了“抄袭”游戏，并引用一位经理的话——对方不以为然地表示，玩家很快就会成为不知原作的一代人，因此只需做表面改动就够了。

为说明这一危险，MTJ写了一个科幻短剧：在“不久的将来”，一位设计师将一款山寨游戏标题输入他称为“帕库灵机器人”（Pakuringu Robotto，“Rip-O-Bot”）的机器。只需按下随机选择键，机器人就能生成背景、角色及其他元素，产出一部“抄袭游戏的杰作”。MTJ警告说，当这样的机器人问世时，普通设计师将大量失业——他并问读者，是否仍有动力和独创力去竞争。他的核心论点是：“归根结底，游戏就是创意！”他认为，画面很快就会变得与现实难以区分，因此外观是一条死路；独创性才是最后仅存的武器。

这篇文章还附有一段令人感慨的注记：手冢治虫刚于1989年2月去世，MTJ问道，“游戏界的手冢治虫”是否会出现——这是从相反方向切入的同一个问题。

MTJ于2008年去世，早于当今的生成式AI，但他的预言与AI极为相似。文章作者指出，这启发了他自己的游戏制作工具Jinks——该工具旨在将设计师从重复性工作中解放出来，使其专注于创意与系统。来源：《GAMEST》第31期，1989年4月，作者辅以机器辅助翻译。

title: Cloudflare Workers and Containers now support inbound TCP connections and gRPC
summary:
Cloudflare announced support for inbound TCP connections and gRPC on its Workers and Containers platform, introduced in private beta during Agents Week.

The key additions include:

- **`connect(socket)` handler**: A new Workers runtime feature that lets a Worker accept an inbound TCP socket from Spectrum (Cloudflare’s non-HTTP ingress proxy). The socket can be passed between Workers, Durable Objects, and Containers, giving developers full control over routing TCP traffic.

- **Bidirectional gRPC from Containers**: Developers can deploy gRPC servers in containers on Cloudflare in any language, with full-duplex, bidirectional streaming support. This enables low-latency voice AI and real-time applications across Cloudflare’s 330+ locations.

- **Workers as gRPC servers/clients**: Using the gRPC-web protocol, Workers can serve unary and server-streaming gRPC APIs and make outbound calls to external gRPC servers. Cloudflare automatically converts incoming gRPC to gRPC-web and outgoing gRPC-web to gRPC, meaning existing clients and servers don’t need changes. Examples include building gRPC backends for mobile apps or placing a Worker in front of an existing gRPC backend.

The article includes code snippets demonstrating socket handling, container connections, and a simple gRPC server in Go, plus a unary gRPC server and client written in a Worker using the @connectrpc/connect package.

Cloudflare says it will work with a small set of developers in the private beta first, and plans to eventually expand into UDP-based protocols. Interested developers can sign up for the beta via a linked form.

- **来自 Containers 的双向 gRPC**：开发者可以在 Cloudflare 的容器中以任何语言部署 gRPC 服务器，支持全双工、双向流式传输。这使得语音 AI 和实时应用能够在 Cloudflare 的 330+ 个地点实现低延迟服务。

文章包含代码示例，演示了 socket 处理、容器连接以及用 Go 编写的简单 gRPC 服务器，还有一个使用 @connectrpc/connect 包在 Worker 中编写的一元 gRPC 服务器和客户端。

Cloudflare 表示将首先与一小部分开发者合作进行私有测试，并计划最终扩展到基于 UDP 的协议。感兴趣的开发者可以通过链接表单注册测试版。

title: Octane – React’s programming model, compiled
summary: Octane introduces a compiled approach to React’s programming model, aiming to remove manual dependency management and rigid Hook rules. Instead of relying on dependency arrays for `useEffect`, `useMemo`, and `useCallback`, the compiler automatically tracks which values each construct actually uses. This means hooks can safely live inside conditions or after early returns, because the compiler understands their real dependencies rather than enforcing static placement rules. The result is a more natural, less constrained coding experience: developers write logic without worrying about stale closures, missing dependencies, or exhaustive-deps lint errors. Octane effectively shifts React’s runtime and mental overhead into compile time, making the programming model simpler and more intuitive while preserving correctness and performance.
chinese_title: Octane——React的编程模型，编译版
chinese_summary: Octane 为 React 的编程模型引入了一种编译式方法，旨在消除手动依赖管理和僵化的 Hook 规则。它不再依赖 `useEffect`、`useMemo` 和 `useCallback` 的依赖数组，而是由编译器自动追踪每个构造实际使用的值。这意味着 Hook 可以安全地放在条件语句中或提前返回之后，因为编译器理解它们的真实依赖，而不是强制执行静态的位置规则。结果是更自然、更少约束的编码体验：开发者编写逻辑时无需担心过期的闭包、缺失的依赖或 exhaustive-deps 的 lint 错误。Octane 有效地将 React 的运行时和心智负担转移到编译期，使编程模型更简单、更直观，同时保持正确性和性能。
